extension.description: Sorts class members of Java files, following Eclipse's Sort Members rules. Only sorts, no formatting.
command.title: Java Sorter: Sort Members (Eclipse Style)
config.sortConstants: Whether to sort class constants (such as enum constants).
config.sortByVisibility: Whether to sort group members by visibility descending (Public -> Protected -> Package -> Private).
config.distinguishStaticMethods: Whether to distinguish static methods into a separate group (otherwise sorted together with instance methods).
config.distinguishConstructors: Whether to distinguish constructors into a separate group (otherwise sorted together with instance methods).
